topic: Elvis and James Brown — the mutual respect between the two Kings
script: In August 1977, the Godfather of Soul sat motionless in a corner of Graceland's living room. Elvis Presley was dead at forty-two. Their story began eleven years earlier, at a Jackie Wilson show in a Hollywood nightclub. George Klein, Elvis's friend, had arranged the introduction. Elvis did not wait for James Brown to be brought over. He asked to be taken to James. From that night, they were friends. In the years that followed, Brown came to Graceland, sometimes unannounced. Klein remembered nights the two men spent singing gospel songs together. Then came the news. Brown called Klein and asked to come to the house for the private viewing. He came, and sat in that corner a long while. Months later, he released his own recording of "Love Me Tender." Brown would later say it simply. I wasn't just a fan. I was his brother.
